history.note: test corrected in its own phase; reviewed by the inspector and the human

requirement_quote: When HAL_IWDG_Init receives valid arguments, the IWDG driver shall write 0xCCCC followed by 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY before configuring the prescaler and reload, and write 0xAAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY only if IWDG_SR.PVU and IWDG_SR.RVU both equal zero within the supplied timeout.
summary: Corrected incomplete SWR-002 target observation: TCHECK(2), already asserted by the Robot test, now names KR.KEY and both update flags. KR is write-only and correctly reads zero in the behavioural model; both flags must be clear after successful initialization. The previous check named only ONF and status, leaving SWR-002 unobserved.
